package.name: bev_pipeline
package.description: Robocentric BEV / 3D-volumetric behavioral-state classification pipeline. Non-destructive replacement for the clustering package's planar-slice + HDBSCAN approach: builds a gravity-aligned BEV raster (or coarse voxel grid) per frame, extracts features via one of several swappable candidates, and classifies with a supervised model trained on trajectory-derived labels. Publishes the same /predicted_cluster Int16 contract nl_planner consumes, plus a richer /predicted_state JSON topic.
